verdict.rationale: Ramp explicitly documents instant virtual card issuance scoped per-vendor/purpose (e.g. per-software-subscription cards with per-vendor spending limits, real-time visibility, no shared card numbers), plus card management via CLI (cards resource, funds/creds/lock) and community confirmation of spinning up a new card in under a minute. Missing for 10: no explicit first-party UI walkthrough/screenshot of scoping a card specifically to 'ad spend' campaigns, and no independent/third-party review specifically validating purpose-based scoping controls beyond vendor-level limits.
